anchor.quote: The variable of the ring is $y$, an indeterminate that is not evaluated at any number.
The number of complex coefficients in the list of one element is $r$, a power of two.
$\theta$ is the twist factor, a complex $2r$-th root of unity with $\theta^r=-1$

gaps.term: twist of a list equals the coefficient list of a(θy), and the product of twisted lists
gaps.quote: So the product of two twisted lists is the twist of their cyclic convolution.
gaps.note: The page never states that the twisted list of a coefficient list is the coefficient list of the substituted polynomial a(θy), nor which product the twisted lists are multiplied under. The substitution x=θy is only asserted to preserve sums and products, so the reader cannot check that the ring product of two twisted lists equals the twist of their cyclic convolution.
